desc: Initialize heap_type2 with all intervals as (-L_i, i) and sort intervals by L_i for pointer-based addition
In the main loop, add intervals with L_i <= cur to heap_type1 or heap_finish, and clean all heaps
Choose the best action: finish if heap_finish non-empty, else max R_i from heap_type1, else max L_i from heap_type2
Mark operation as used, set its type, update cost and cur accordingly
Output total cost and the operation types for indices 1..M
Test the algorithm with the provided sample inputs to verify correctness
Handle edge cases (no solution, single element, overlapping intervals)
Ensure efficiency for N up to 1e6 and M up to 2e5
Verify the finish condition logic: when R_i < cur we can use type2 to set all positions outside [L_i,R_i] to 1, which finishes if L_i <= cur (otherwise some positions remain zero)
Confirm that using type2 with L_i > cur jumps to L_i correctly covers positions from cur to L_i-1 by setting complement
Check that intervals are only added to heap_type1 when L_i <= cur <= R_i, and to heap_finish when R_i < cur (and L_i <= cur)
